scope: Foundational results, barriers, restricted lower bounds, conditional bridges, structured SAT algorithms, proof automation and representative claimed resolutions. This receipt preserves the JANUS attack logic without treating the corpus as a proof.
janus_attack_gates: No promotion from survival to proof

hypothesis_seeds.name: Certificate-Discovery Width Hypothesis
hypothesis_seeds.statement: A useful universal SAT certificate portfolio must bound not only certificate width/size but the polynomial cost of selecting the proof language and discovering the certificate.
hypothesis_seeds.attack: Construct families with short certificates in different languages but NP-hard portfolio selection.

hypothesis_seeds.name: Nonlinear Quotient Separator Hypothesis
hypothesis_seeds.statement: After exact elimination of tractable fracture leaves, some instances may admit polynomially discoverable incidence separators with proof-carrying boundary messages of polynomial total volume.
hypothesis_seeds.attack: Use expander/Tseitin/random-CNF families to force separator width or message diversity to grow.

hypothesis_seeds.name: Barrier-Transversal Instance Property
hypothesis_seeds.statement: A successful lower-bound invariant may need to be instance-specific, non-large, non-black-box, and certificate-backed, thereby avoiding the usual naturalness and relativization patterns.
hypothesis_seeds.attack: Test whether the property is secretly constructive and large, or whether membership testing already requires the hard language.

hypothesis_seeds.name: Algorithm–Lower-Bound Dual Search
hypothesis_seeds.statement: A nontrivial SAT algorithm for a carefully expanding circuit/proof class can either yield a new lower bound or expose the precise feature preventing extension toward general circuits.
hypothesis_seeds.attack: At each expansion step, verify that the SAT speedup remains nontrivial and does not rely on class-specific collapse unavailable in the next class.

hypothesis_seeds.name: Proof-Carrying Semantic Merge
hypothesis_seeds.statement: Residual states should merge only through independently checkable semantic certificates whose discovery and total replay cost are polynomial.
hypothesis_seeds.attack: Reduce general residual equivalence to equivalence with FALSE and search for exponential certificate diversity.

integration.odontoforge: Use the attack deck to prevent finite search reductions from being promoted to P=NP.
integration.p_n_junction_lineage: Require aggregate work, witness recovery and standard-model accounting.
integration.proof_carrying_engine: Use discovery cost and independent UNSAT-certificate gates as first-class constraints.

claim_boundary: P_VS_NP = OPEN. This receipt is an adversarial research checklist, not evidence for either resolution.
